controls.title: Screen personnel before granting access
controls.statement: Verify identity, eligibility and role-appropriate trustworthiness before personnel receive access, and repeat screening when risk or role requires it.
controls.risk: A person using a false identity or unsuitable for a sensitive role could gain trusted access to information, systems or facilities.
controls.scope: Employees, contractors and other personnel before access, plus roles subject to rescreening.
controls.examine: Sample personnel files, identity and eligibility checks, role risk ratings, screening outcomes, access dates and rescreening records.
controls.interview: Ask personnel-security and hiring owners how screening depth is chosen and how adverse or incomplete results affect access.
controls.test: Compare sampled access activation dates with completed screening and verify rescreening occurred for selected higher-risk roles.
controls.expected: Required checks finish before access is authorised, screening matches role risk and required rescreening is current.

mappings.basis: Requires a pre-employment identity check for all personnel to the specified assurance level.
Requires a pre-employment eligibility check for all personnel.
Requires appropriate employment screening or security clearance before system access.
Requires screening before access and rescreening under defined conditions.
Requires screening at hire and periodically for positions with access to important assets.

controls.title: Secure personnel transfers and departures
controls.statement: Coordinate role changes and departures so access, credentials and organisational property are changed or recovered within approved timeframes.
controls.risk: Departed or transferred personnel could retain access or property that allows unauthorised activity after their business need has ended.
controls.scope: Employment termination, transfer and extended absence affecting logical or physical access.
controls.examine: Compare personnel events with disabled access, revoked credentials, returned property, retained records and documented transfer decisions.
controls.interview: Ask managers, HR and access owners how urgent departures and role changes are coordinated.
controls.test: Sample departures and transfers and calculate the time to remove or amend each relevant access path and recover assigned property.
controls.expected: Access and credentials change within approved deadlines, property is recovered and continuing access follows the new role.

mappings.basis: Requires access disablement, credential revocation, exit discussion, property recovery and retention of organisational information after termination.
Requires separation and transfer procedures to address cybersecurity, including supplementary vetting where appropriate.
